newsitem.title: USA: Uniphase crumbles as revenues disappoint.
newsitem.headline: Uniphase crumbles as revenues disappoint.

text.p: Uniphase Corp's share price tumbled Friday after the company said revenues had slowed in its key sector due to manufacturing problems.
The company had problems obtaining lasers used as components in certain transmitters made by its fast-growing UTP Optoelectronics sector, analysts said.

While the bottom-line numbers for Uniphase's second quarter met analysts' expectations, the composition of the revenues disappointed Wall Street, said Josephthal Lyon & Ross analyst Jay Vleeschhouwer.
"The revenue composition was different than expected. The numbers were okay, but their most visible sector had problems. They made up for that shortfall in other areas," Vleeschhouwer.
After the market closed on Thursday, Uniphase posted second quarter earnings of $0.18 a share on net sales of $22.7 million, up from $0.14 a share on net sales of $15.7 million a year earlier.
The manufacturing constraints could linger through the fiscal third quarter but are not likely to materially hurt results, analysts said.

Vleeschhouwer said he has not lowered his earnings estimates for the company for the rest of 1997. He expects Uniphase to earn $0.23 a share in the third quarter, ending in March, and $0.29 a share for the fourth quarter.
